messages:
elaine_pm: Quick thread - we need a tight rollout pattern for routing-fallbacks that covers hosted + dedicated (private later). Focus: deterministic fallbacks, per-tenant opt-in, clear bake windows, and a rollback ladder. Need a small decision list by EOD Weds.

igor_eng: Proposal: staggered-island rollout. Flow = shadow -> micro-canary (0.25%) -> regional micro (1%) -> tenant-cohort (opt-in) -> regional ramp (10%) -> broad ramp (25%). Regions: asia-south1 -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 (start low-traffic).

nina_sre: SRE gates: monitor p99 delta, absolute error-rate, fallback_invocations, host_cpu. Auto soft-rollback if p99 > +20% OR error-rate +0.3% abs for 5m -> reduce slice to 0.1% snapshot. Hard rollback = tenant kill or global kill (manual). Add 20m cooldown between escalations. Also require KV/cache priming dry-run.

omar_support: Support asks: portal opt-in for up to 12 customers, one-click rollback in portal for opt-ins, webhook notifications for tenant-level kills, and a customer-facing status blurb template. We'll manage comms if provided a canned message.

devops: Flag schema suggestion (typed config keys): ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.scope={global|region|tenant}, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.kill.global, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.kill.tenant:<id>, ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.dry_run. Audit every toggle and emit immutable audit events. Example snippet (pseudo): 
```
{
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled": true,
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct": 1,
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.scope": "region"
}
```

legal: Private deployments must pass KMS verification + DPA checks before enabling fallback routing. Block Private until legal sign-off and key validation.

igor_eng: Telemetry/sampling plan: 100% trace capture for micro-canary (volume small), 20% sampling at 1%, 5% at 5%, stop sampling beyond 25% except on-trigger. Store traces encrypted and redact PII. Provide a small dashboard: slice_pct, p50/p95/p99, error-rate, fallback_invocations, reroute_rate by region/tenant. 1m resolution preferred.

nina_sre: A/B vs canary rule: A/B only for UX/quality metrics (helpfulness proxies, token usage). Canary for infra/latency. Ensure cohorts do not overlap (no double exposure). Add per-tenant kill-switch that can be toggled automatically on thresholds.

elaine_pm: Summary decisions: 1) Staggered-island flow (shadow -> 0.25% -> 1% -> tenant opt-in -> 10% -> 25+) 2) Region order asia-south1 -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 3) Flag schema with v1 + per-scope kill and dry_run 4) Telemetry sampling + dashboard + PII redaction 5) Portal opt-in for up to 12 customers + one-click rollback 6) Private blocked until legal/KMS sign-off 7) Soft-auto rollback -> tenant kill -> region manual -> global manual.

ops-bot: created RI-21001 - rollout-automation (assign: igor_eng/devops/nina_sre) and RI-21002 - portal-optin (assign: devops/omar_support). Dry-run scheduled 2026-04-14T08:00:00Z.

igor_eng: Action items: i'll own rollout script + dry-run PR. devops: flag wiring + audit + webhook. nina_sre: gate automation + runbook. omar_support: customer comms + portal flow. legal: KMS checklist. elaine_pm: sign-off after dry-run.

elaine_pm: Cool. If anything missing call it out now or DM. :thumbsup:
